description: openmod Initiative wiki (open energy models and data) is a community wiki listed in openmod Initiative wiki, a community wiki of open energy models and data, published or maintained by openmod Initiative (open energy modelling community). It holds fact sheets for about 87 open energy system models with licence, software, sectors and resolution, link lists to open data for energy modelling (demand, weather, networks, power plants, technology costs, scenarios and policies), and a page of regional open model implementations. Coverage: worldwide, with a European emphasis. Fact sheets follow one template, so the entries can be compared, but many pages carry no update date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is wiki content licence not read; the listed models and data carry their own terms. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding open energy models and modelling data. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-openmod-initiative-wiki.
